acceptedRuntime.notes: 47f85a37 is the accepted fork head containing the iris_agent#41 production-lock fix chain (lock surface, validator --verify-git, CI unshallow gate). Its tree is the immutable identity consumers must verify (git rev-parse 47f85a37^{tree}). Prior accepted identities 91bfa59a and fa7aba0a/e18f7dd are ancestors with earlier trees; the accepted identity always covers the fixed lock surface itself. acceptedRuntime is the single authoritative identity for the Pi runtime iris_agent is allowed to consume; floating main is never an accepted identity.
